ep_context_confidence.question: How completely does the captured traffic context represent this endpoint's security-relevant behaviour (parameters, authentication and data flows all visible)?

ep_generic_risk.question: How security-test-worthy is this endpoint overall, considering its parameters, data sensitivity and captured behaviour?
criteria: No test relevance: public/static content, no meaningful inputs
Low relevance: inputs exist but no sensitive data or state control
Moderate relevance: business data involved, worth selective testing
High relevance: sensitive data, identity or state control present
Very high relevance: multiple sensitive dimensions or risky behaviour observed
